Cat Grooming | Ear Cleaning | Custom Styling | Minneapolis, MN

We've been grooming pets in the Minneapolis area for more than three decades. We may not be able to guarantee how your cat will react to a treatment, but we can promise that you couldn't find more experience or skill anywhere else. Our services include:
Short and long haired cat washing and nail trims
Flea and tick dips, ear cleaning, and teeth brushing
Custom clipping and styling, medicated baths, and more

If you have any questions regarding our cat grooming services or if you would simply like to speak with our staff, please contact us . Our staff has the knowledge, patience, and care need to provide your pet with an enjoyable grooming experience.
Get expert cat grooming services from a caring professional. Call us today!

It doesn't matter if your dog is young or old, big or small - we've got the experience and passion to care for whatever needs your pet may have. We offer a variety of services to make sure your furry friend is clean, happy, and healthy. Our services include:
Washing, teeth brushing, and nail trimming
Flea and tick dips, custom styling, and medicated baths
Your dog's comfort is our priority

As soon as you meet our staff and see us interact with your pet, you will understand how much we enjoy the company of animals. From bath time to beauty time, you can count on us to work to keep your best friend calm and comfortable.
